title: Good Sunsets Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Good Sunsets is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Good Sunsets | Two Seaside Homes, One Four-Bedroom RetreatGood Sunsets is a unique Seaside, Florida vacation rental that combines two separate homes—Goodobbies and Sunsets on Savannah—rented together as one four-bedroom retreat. Located just 118 feet from the beach and a short walk from Seaside’s Central Square, the property accommodates up to 12 guests and offers three king suites, multiple indoor and outdoor gathering spaces, and the flexibility of two separate living areas. This layout is especially well suited for large families, multigenerational vacations, celebrations, and groups traveling together who want to stay close while maintaining some private space.Two Homes Rented Together in SeasideThe main home, Goodobbies, is a three-bedroom, three-bath Seaside vacation home designed for comfortable group stays. Its spacious wraparound screened porch provides multiple seating areas and outdoor dining, creating an inviting space for morning coffee, family meals, or relaxing after a day at the beach.Inside, the first floor features an open living area with two sofas, a large flat-screen TV, and a dining table with seating for ten. A separate media area includes a large TV, Sonos soundbar, and bar nook with a beverage refrigerator. The renovated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a four-burner gas range with griddle, Sub-Zero refrigerator, and breakfast nook with seating for five.Comfortable Bedrooms for Families and GroupsTwo bedrooms are located on the first floor. The bunk room sleeps four with two twin bunk beds and includes a workspace, custom storage, and flat-screen TV. A nearby full bathroom features a walk-in shower. The first-floor king bedroom includes a sitting area, workspace, and private ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. The entire second floor is dedicated to the primary king suite, creating a private retreat with an ensuite bathroom featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and separate shower. An enclosed third-floor tower provides an additional quiet space to relax while enjoying views of Seaside and the Gulf.Separate Guest House for Added PrivacyLocated just behind Goodobbies, Sunsets on Savannah is a separate guest house that accommodates up to four additional guests. This unique setup is ideal for multigenerational families, grandparents, adult children, or friends traveling together who want to stay near the main group while having their own living and sleeping spaces. The first floor includes a comfortable living area with a queen sleeper sofa, flat-screen TV, renovated full bathroom, and washer and dryer. Upstairs, the open king bedroom features a flat-screen TV, half bath, and efficiency kitchenette with an under-counter refrigerator, bar sink, microwave, and toaster. Bar seating for two provides a convenient spot for morning coffee or casual meals.Outdoor Gathering SpacesBetween the two homes is a spacious open-air dining deck with seating for up to ten and a pellet grill, making it easy to gather for family dinners and evening meals. Guests also have access to an outdoor shower and a full laundry room on the main level.118 Feet to the Beach in SeasideGood Sunsets offers an exceptional Seaside location just 118 feet from the beach. Guests can easily walk to the sand, then continue into Seaside to enjoy Central Square, restaurants, shops, events, and other town amenities. The combination of two separate homes, four bedrooms, three king suites, accommodations for up to 12 guests, and a location just steps from the beach makes Good Sunsets particularly well suited for larger families and groups looking for a flexible Seaside vacation rental.* 5-night minimum Summer, Spring & Spring Break, 3-night minimum Fall, 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.Features:Features 2,548 square feet*18 feet to private beach access at Savannah Pavilion; Seaside is the largest residential private beach on 30ATesla Universal Wall Connector is provided for guest usePlasma TVs throughout home, Sonos sound bar in livingPole-mounted pellet grill is available for guest use (shared with guest home)Outdoor gas grill is inoperable and not for guest useOutdoor showerDriveway with private parkingOutdoor fireplace is decorative and not for guest useAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply) and a fitness center.Welcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit Authority2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.Pet Friendly. Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $100 per day rental pet fee will be collected in addition to the flat $150 pet fee for three-bedroom homes. Pets will not be allowed on furniture.
